title: transfer-deadlock
blurb: Peer transfers work one at a time, but opposite A→B and B→A transfers hang forever under load. Classic lock ordering.
brief:
This transfer service moves money between named accounts. Single-threaded transfers pass, but finance's soak test deadlocks when two workers move money in opposite directions at the same time.

Run the tests. `test_concurrent_opposite_transfers` starts two threads — one moves **alice → bob**, the other **bob → alice** — and expects both to finish with balances unchanged. Instead the threads hang.

**Your job:** fix the locking in `transfer/service.py` so opposite-direction transfers can't deadlock. Keep unrelated account pairs able to transfer in parallel.
